policy: regression guardrail; improvement over the default backend is not required
revision_note: Revision 1's 33.334 ms fluid p95 was retired after the Linux pilot because it imposed an unrequested 30 FPS target on a Rapier-only capability with no default-backend baseline. Revision 2 retained the 100 ms ceiling and added spread/memory checks. Revisions 3-4 controlled and recorded CPU affinity. Revision 5 replaced Redot's block-updated headless TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS monitor with direct wall-clock physics-frame intervals. Revision 6 replaces the scale-unstable p95 spread ratio with a p95 range capped at one configured 60 Hz physics tick (16.667 ms). Revision 7 records only the host platform's release-library hash so single-platform CI jobs can run without fabricating a foreign binary. Revision 8 canonicalizes text-contract line endings before hashing so Windows CRLF and Linux LF checkouts prove the same source; workloads and numerical thresholds remain unchanged.
aggregation: three runs; wall-clock intervals between consecutive physics-frame signals; pooled frame samples; nearest-rank p95; median; maximum static-memory monitor
